answer: In an autonomous AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake functions as a vital defense relic, raising operational barriers to a punishing nadir for malicious actors attempting mass identity forgery. By requiring agents to lock capital in a secure smart contract—akin to anchoring security deep within a flexible willow network—the protocol forces an attacker to incur prohibitive financial costs proportional to every fabricated persona. This direct economic friction neutralizes large-scale Sybil flooding.
